prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: full-bleed watercolor landscape background for the existing "Find a crew" mobile action card. This is background artwork only, never an app screenshot or UI mockup.
Input image: the attached current find-crew.webp is the EDIT TARGET and exact reference for the watercolor painting style, landscape palette, proportions and composition.
Primary request: replace the three standing hikers on the RIGHT with a family of exactly FOUR people — two adults and two children — all sitting outdoors in front of a small camping CARAVAN TRAILER at a grassy campsite. They are relaxing together in camping chairs around a tiny low table, looking toward each other with warm, natural body language. Make both children clearly recognizable as children, with smaller proportions. Keep each of the four people visually distinct and complete. The family is the foreground subject; the caravan is behind them. The caravan is a non-motorized cream travel trailer with subtle pale teal trim, a visible tow bar and simple side window, NOT a campervan or motorhome.
Composition: keep the full family and caravan together in the rightmost 35% of the panorama. Place the family mainly between x=72% and x=96%, heads near y=48%, feet near y=84%; the caravan behind them within x=65% to x=97% and y=34% to y=73%. Keep comfortable margins so the whole scene survives a mobile cover crop. The left 60% stays an uninterrupted quiet mountain meadow and softly layered pine valley, with no people, furniture or objects, for our existing text overlay. Retain the distant blue mountain ridges, sage and pine greens, pale cream sunlight, delicate hand-painted watercolor pigment and fine textured paper from the original. Integrate the campsite naturally into the meadow rather than placing cutouts onto the painting. Keep the 2:1 landscape format and edge-to-edge painted background.
Constraints: exactly four human figures in total, two adults and two children, all sitting together; no standing hikers; no additional people, cars, campervans, tents or campfire. No text, typography, UI, icons, buttons, badges, logos, branding, number plates, frames or borders. No photography, 3D render, plastic cartoon or vector-art style. Do not bake a text gradient or lettering into the art. Preserve the calm landscape and existing watercolor medium; change only the right-hand subject to the requested family campsite.
